commands.name: shape
commands.owns: Clarify job, audience, proof, states, constraints, and return a design brief without code.

commands.name: inspire
commands.owns: Inspect references, generate Design DNA, synthesize a multi-source direction, and record transformations and influence.

commands.name: create
commands.owns: Create or replace a complete visual world and surface.

commands.name: page
commands.owns: Build a cinematic landing page, story, gallery, or immersive web surface.

commands.name: deck
commands.owns: Build an immersive sales, sponsorship, launch, or presentation deck.

commands.name: interface
commands.owns: Build or improve product UI, dashboards, tools, editors, or resource systems.

commands.name: asset
commands.owns: Choose, source, generate, render, optimize, and manifest video or 3D media.

commands.name: layout
commands.owns: Repair hierarchy, grouping, density, structure, and responsive behavior.

commands.name: typeset
commands.owns: Choose or repair type roles, font systems, measure, and delivery.

commands.name: color
commands.owns: Choose or repair palette strategy, semantic roles, contrast, material, and surface hierarchy.

commands.name: animate
commands.owns: Define and implement one focal motion system plus supporting state transitions.

commands.name: critique
commands.owns: Assess product clarity, composition, world coherence, interaction, media, and implementation.

commands.name: polish
commands.owns: Finish a working surface without changing its product truth or visual authority.

commands.name: resolve
commands.owns: Render, detect, rank, repair, rerender, and verify a complete surface until the mechanical gate and explicit visual review pass.

commands.name: audit
commands.owns: Run deterministic, inspiration, browser, asset, registry, and provenance checks.

commands.name: extract
commands.owns: Promote proven patterns into tokens, recipes, registry items, or skills.

commands.name: install
commands.owns: Find and install the smallest registry item or external component source that solves the need.

commands.name: eval
commands.owns: Score a finished surface against the AIgent rubrics without inventing results.
